prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE production sprite sheet PNG containing eight individually painted whole-body stationary prone-observation animation cels for an existing detailed side-view modern-warfare game.

Reference image: infantry-stance-v142.png is a reference only, not an edit target. Use ONLY the final, fully prone BOTTOM-RIGHT cel (row 4, column 4) for anatomy, low pose, proportions, character identity, painted detailing and colors. Ignore every other cel in that reference, including all upright, kneeling, transition and higher prone poses. Do not reproduce its original grid.

Scene/backdrop: genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the eight soldiers. No background color, no cyan key, no checkerboard painted into the image, no floor, no cast shadow, no UI, no text, no frame lines.

Subject/style: the same right-facing rifleman in all eight drawings, seen strictly from the side, full body from boot tips at left to rifle muzzle at right. Match the reference's neutral olive-brown, detailed painted WWII-ish-modern tactical kit: olive helmet, muted worn cloth, small dark webbing/pouches, brown-olive backpack and boots, dark rifle. Crisp coherent anatomy, textured fabric and readable painted edges. Each cel is a complete individually painted soldier, never disconnected skeletal parts.

Composition: exactly TWO COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS of equal wide rectangular cells; reading order left-to-right then top-to-bottom is cel0 through cel7. Prefer a 1536 x 1024 PNG canvas, so each cell is 768 x 256. Keep each whole soldier comfortably inside its cell, approximately x=60 to x=708 in cell-local coordinates, with its contact baseline near local y=210. Generous truly transparent margins and gutters, including a large clear gap between rows and between columns. All boot tips, backpack, helmet, elbows, fingers and complete rifle muzzle inside each cell. No visible grid or labels.

Critical pose invariant: ALWAYS fully belly-down, extremely low and stationary. Belly, hips, thighs and both elbows remain resting on the SAME ground-contact baseline in every cel. Shoulders stay low; chest never rises onto straight arms. Legs extend left in the same resting pose without stepping or flexing into a crawl. Boot, hip and elbow horizontal anchor positions remain fixed. Rifle supported by both hands, aimed horizontally right, same length, height and body-relative proportions throughout. Keep total torso/helmet vertical envelope around one-quarter of equivalent standing adult height: about 17 gameplay pixels prone compared with 63 standing, NOT the raised 23-25-pixel crawling silhouette. Relative to its long whole-body-plus-rifle silhouette, the soldier should read as a very low flattened prone profile matching the bottom-right reference. The body is naturally prone, not distorted or squashed anatomy.

Eight progressive cels forming a continuous subtle breathing/observation loop:
cel0, top left: ready low, resting on belly and elbows, relaxed alert eyes.
cel1, top right: tiny head/neck look forward, chin moves subtly forward, no shoulder or body lift.
cel2, second row left: mild inhale conveyed by tiny upper-back fabric/chest contour change while belly and elbows remain grounded.
cel3, second row right: held alert breath, focused forward gaze, unchanged grounded low silhouette.
cel4, third row left: soft exhale; the tiny cloth/upper-back change reverses.
cel5, third row right: settle back into the same low resting pose.
cel6, bottom left: subtle blink and head return, keeping the rifle supported and low.
cel7, bottom right: ready pose matched to cel0 for a smooth loop closure.
Differences should be small but intentionally drawn in face, neck, cloth and breath contours; no translated or rescaled body between frames. Keep helmet, weapon, equipment and limb anatomy consistent.

Strict avoid: any shoulder push-up; crawling; leg steps; raised knees; crouching or kneeling; hand signals; raised hand; reloading; whole-body elevation; firing, muzzle flash or smoke; perspective change; cropped extremities; extra soldiers, limbs or weapons; skeletal cutouts; extra cels; labels; shadows or ground. Produce only this one transparent PNG sheet.
